name: Amphibious
effect: No tests for underwater movement; double speed while swimming

name: Amorphous
effect: All hits go to body; double Hit Points

name: Armor Plating
effect: Natural armor rating X to all locations

name: Aura
effect: Aura X reduces magical damage; protects all locations

name: Auto-Stabilized
effect: Always counts as braced; may fire full-auto as a half action

name: Caster
effect: Can cast spells; school ranks listed. Counts as sanctioned

name: Crawler
effect: Speed halved; no terrain penalties

name: Daemonic
effect: Extra HP and armor equal to Constitution; stacks with all armor

name: Dark Sight
effect: See normally in total darkness; no lighting penalties

name: Fear
effect: Opponents must pass fear test at the listed rating

name: Flyer
effect: Can fly at listed speed (default double ground speed)

name: Machine
effect: Inorganic; immune to vacuum, cold, mind effects; armor X to all locations

name: Mindless
effect: No Cha/Fel/Cmp/Int; auto-fail social tests; immune to mind control

name: Phasing
effect: Can become incorporeal (half action); immune to normal weapons while phasing

name: Quadruped
effect: Ground speed doubled

name: Regeneration
effect: Regain X Hit Points at the start of each turn

name: Resource Stat
effect: Has a resource pool following normal resource stat rules

name: Stuff of Nightmares
effect: Immune to poison, disease, breathing, bleeding, stunning; death only from Spell/Power Weapon criticals

name: Undead
effect: No need to breathe/eat/drink; immune to blood loss, fatigue, and stunning

name: Unnatural Toughness
effect: Hit Points are doubled (including Sound Constitution)
